facebook.content:
“Seek first the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things will be added to you.” — Matt 6:33  

The kingdom is not a future hope; it’s a present authority that demands our priorities now. When we align our daily decisions with His reign, provision follows as a natural outflow of His rule.  

What kingdom‑first priority will you claim today?

tiktok.content:
“Therefore the kingdom of God is within you.” — Luke 17:21  
The Kingdom isn’t a future hope; it’s the authority already dwelling in every believer’s spirit. Activate it now—let your thoughts, words, and deeds reflect His reign.  

What Kingdom‑power are you releasing today?
